potato_Early_Blight.preventive_measures: Avoid overhead irrigation, increase crop spacing, and prune lower leaves.

potato_Healthy.symptoms: No signs of fungal, bacterial, or viral infection detected on this Potato leaf.

soybean_Bacterial_Blight.symptoms: Angular translucent water-soaked spots turning dark brown or black on Soybean leaves.

soybean_Bacterial_Blight.organic_solution: Apply Copper Hydroxide or Panchagavya foliar spray (30ml/L).
soybean_Bacterial_Blight.preventive_measures: Use disease-free certified seeds and sterilize pruning tools between fields.

soybean_Rust.symptoms: Powdery orange, brown, or yellow pustules forming on Soybean leaves and stems.
soybean_Rust.treatment: Apply Propiconazole 25% EC (1 ml/L) or Tebuconazole (1.5 ml/L) at first sight of pustules.
soybean_Rust.medicine: Tilt 25 EC, Folicur 250 EC, Mancozeb 75 WP
soybean_Rust.organic_solution: Foliar spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Trichoderma viride (5g/L).
soybean_Rust.preventive_measures: Use certified rust-resistant seed varieties and eliminate alternate weed hosts.

sugarcane_Mosaic.symptoms: Severe leaf curling, mottling, stunting, or mosaic yellow discoloration on Sugarcane plants.
sugarcane_Mosaic.treatment: No direct cure for viral infection. Control vector insects (whiteflies/aphids) using Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (0.5 ml/L).
sugarcane_Mosaic.organic_solution: Install yellow sticky traps (10/acre) and spray Neem oil (10ml/L) to control vectors.
sugarcane_Mosaic.preventive_measures: Uproot and burn infected plants immediately to stop vector transmission.
